title: Farm Labor Onboarding Request Form
subtitle: Farm Labor Onboarding: defines need, constraints, and assignment.
description: Farm Labor Onboarding Request Form covers worker assignment, age or eligibility record, training, equipment authorization, housing or transport need, and supervisor handoff. The farm workforce coordinator records Farm Labor Onboarding need, timing, access, and assignment. Farm Labor Onboarding Request Form keeps Farm Labor Onboarding exceptions visible until the farm workforce coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Farm Labor Onboarding Request Form at farm office, field assignment, packing area, equipment zone, and worker support location. Document worker assignment, age or eligibility record, training, equipment authorization, housing or transport need, and supervisor handoff identity before Farm Labor Onboarding begins. Compare worker assignment, age or eligibility record, training, equipment authorization, housing or transport need, and supervisor handoff findings with stated Farm Labor Onboarding criteria; route unresolved Farm Labor Onboarding issues to authorized human-resources or safety reviewer. For Farm Labor Onboarding Request Form, confirm requirements for Farm Labor Onboarding. Ask authorized human-resources or safety reviewer to review Farm Labor Onboarding conditions beyond the farm workforce coordinator's role.

sections.title: Requester, location, and subject details
sections.guidance: For Farm Labor Onboarding, identify responsible parties, farm office, field assignment, packing area, equipment zone, and worker support location, and the linked worker assignment, age or eligibility record, training, equipment authorization, housing or transport need, and supervisor handoff source.

fields.label: Employer, crew, supervisor, and start date
Job, field, equipment, language, and training assignment

sections.title: Requested result, access, and timing
sections.guidance: Capture Farm Labor Onboarding facts for worker assignment, age or eligibility record, training, equipment authorization, housing or transport need, and supervisor handoff; include result, limit, source, and next control.

blocks.label: Farm Labor Onboarding intake confirmations
items: Requested or already documented: identity and work-eligibility document routing without excess copying
Requested or already documented: job duties, pay basis, schedule, and contact route
Requested or already documented: language and comprehension support
Requested or already documented: hazard, heat, sanitation, emergency, and reporting orientation
Requested or already documented: equipment or vehicle authorization
Requested or already documented: housing, transport, or accommodation routing when offered

sections.title: Request constraints, assignment, and response
sections.guidance: Resolve open Farm Labor Onboarding request questions; have farm workforce coordinator record the assignment, response owner, and requester follow-up while keeping the record strictly at the intake and routing stage.

blocks.label: Scheduling constraints, holds, and supplied evidence
items: Training not understood or available in needed language
Assignment exceeds age, qualification, or restriction
Retaliation-free reporting or emergency route unclear
Prior or requester-supplied: required document verification record
Prior or requester-supplied: training topic and comprehension evidence
Prior or requester-supplied: worker acknowledgment and supervisor handoff
blocks.guidance: Do not assign or authorize the Farm Labor Onboarding request when authorization, comprehension, job restriction, safety orientation, or accountable supervisor handoff remains unresolved. Retain information supplied with the request and route unresolved constraints to farm workforce coordinator.
